name: WeaponTrail
src_typeComment: Drop on a weapon's tip/edge (a thin child transform near the blade, since a TrailRenderer draws from wherever ITS OWN transform has physically moved — this component just centralizes TrailRenderer's many scattered settings into a few clean Inspector fields with sensible defaults, and adds SetTrailActive() for the actual gameplay use case: turn the trail on for the duration of a swing, off otherwise, rather than leaving it emitting constantly.  Pair with Toolkit/VFX/Weapon Trail (an additive glow shader) on the TrailRenderer's material for the stylized energy-trail look — TrailRenderer works with any material, this component doesn't require that specific shader.

src_serialized.name: trailTime
src_serialized.tooltip: How long a point stays part of the trail before fading out of the tail end.

src_serialized.name: activeOnStart
src_serialized.tooltip: Whether the trail starts emitting immediately on Awake — turn off if a combat system will call SetTrailActive(true) itself when a swing begins.

src_members.name: SetTrailActive
src_members.comment: Turns new-point emission on/off — call true at the start of a swing, false at the end. Already- emitted points still fade out naturally over `trailTime` rather than the trail vanishing instantly, which is what TrailRenderer.emitting (not Clear() or enabled) is specifically for.

src_members.name: ClearTrail
src_members.comment: Immediately removes every existing point — use when a weapon teleports/is re-equipped and the OLD trail position would otherwise draw a visible streak across the jump.
